## Changes / 更新

- Plugin details now use `/token-usage` on all supported hosts, avoiding the built-in `/usage` command. The old name is not registered as an alias.
- TTFT prefers native first-token events and history; historical TPS excludes pre-first-token waiting when native timing is available. Older hosts retain fallbacks, and retries isolate timing samples.
- Updated English and Chinese upgrade/compatibility documentation and completed the changelog through 0.4.24.

## Validation / 验证

- Clean install, typecheck, all 269 tests, build, npm pack dry-run and diff checks passed on Linux with Node.js 24.22.1.
- Existing host verification: OpenCode 2.0.28 passed full packaged regression. OpenCode 2.3.0 passed plugin-command coexistence, details and native-performance checks; full compatibility remains unconfirmed because the full smoke suite stopped at a subagent total mismatch (6,350 actual vs 5,080 expected). Host smoke tests were not rerun in this release environment.

插件详情请改用 `/token-usage`；原生 TTFT／历史 TPS 计时优先，旧宿主保留回退。OpenCode 2.3.0 尚未通过完整兼容性验证，详见仓库验证记录。
